assets.description: Four heart chamber meshes (right atrium, right ventricle, left atrium, left ventricle) used as the anatomical foundation of the OrganHeal heart visualization.
assets.derivationNote: NOT a copy of the source asset's mesh data. New geometry (a fresh icosphere per chamber, our own vertex/face data) was conformed to the real chamber SURFACE POSITIONS of the source asset using Blender's Shrinkwrap modifier (NEAREST_SURFACEPOINT mode), then the modifier was applied and the dependency on the source object was severed. This is the same retopology technique used to build new topology over a CT/photogrammetry scan. No vertices, edges, faces, materials, textures, or other authored data from the source file are included in this asset.

source.name: Z-Anatomy
source.originalDataset: BodyParts3D, Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS), Japan

assets.licenseRiskNote: CC BY-SA 4.0's ShareAlike clause requires derivative works to carry the same license. Whether this retopologized asset (new geometry, sampling only real-world anatomical PROPORTIONS/POSITIONS from the source, containing none of the source's own authored mesh data) legally counts as a 'derivative work' under CC BY-SA is a genuine open question that has NOT been resolved by a lawyer. Per the owner's explicit instruction, this asset is being used as reference-informed original geometry, not as a redistributed derivative -- but this file exists specifically so that determination can be revisited before any commercial release. Do not treat this note as legal clearance.
